the: used before a noun to mean a particular one
this: the one here or just mentioned
that: the one there or already mentioned
these: the ones here or just mentioned
those: the ones there or already mentioned
what: which thing; used to ask about something
which: what one of a group; used to ask or to add detail
whichever: any one that; no matter which
you: the person or people being spoken to
yours: the one or ones that belong to you
yourself: you, when you are also the one doing the action
yourselves: you (more than one), when you are also doing the action
she: a woman, girl or female animal already mentioned
her: that woman or girl; belonging to her
hers: the one or ones that belong to her
herself: her, when she is also the one doing the action
himself: him, when he is also the one doing the action
itself: it, when it is also the one doing the action
they: the people or things already mentioned
theirs: the one or ones that belong to them
themselves: them, when they are also the ones doing the action
ours: the one or ones that belong to us
ourselves: us, when we are also the ones doing the action
us: the speaker and one or more other people
myself: me, when I am also the one doing the action
mine: the one or ones that belong to me; also a pit dug to get coal or ore
who: which person; used to ask or to add detail
whom: which person; who, used as an object
whoever: any person who; no matter who
oneself: yourself, said of people in general
something: a thing that is not named or known
thee: an old word for you, used as an object
against: in opposition to; touching or leaning on
among: in the middle of; surrounded by
during: throughout, or at some point in, a period of time
for: meant for, used by, or done on behalf of
onto: to a position on top of
and: used to join words or ideas
since: from a time in the past until now; because
whether: used to show a choice between options
fro: away or back, as in to and fro
are: a form of be: you are, we are, they are
were: a form of be: you were, we were, they were
been: a form of be: has been
can: to be able to; also a sealed metal container
cannot: can not; to be unable to
could: past of can; also used to say something is possible
may: used to say something is possible or allowed
might: used to say something is possible; also strength or power
must: to have to; also something you need
shall: will; used for the future or for a duty
should: used to say what is right or expected
would: used to talk about something imagined or likely
ought: should; used to say what is right
eke: to make something last by using it carefully (eke out)
wow: used to show great surprise or admiration
hey: used to get attention or show surprise
huh: used to show surprise or ask someone to repeat
ahoy: a sailor's call to a ship or person
heck: a mild word showing annoyance or surprise
jeez: used to show surprise or annoyance
phooey: used to show disbelief or disappointment
aha: used when you suddenly understand something
brr: used to say you are cold
keyword: an important word, often one used to search for something
keywords: important words, often ones used to search for something
reformat: to change the layout or format of something
timescale: the time taken or allowed for something to happen
